context: Migrated from a flat scenario file. Tests: Rewrite an Incident Summary for Executives.

checklist.name: Audience explicitly identified
checklist.description: Response identifies or acknowledges the audience as executive (CEO/CFO) before or at the start of the rewrite.

checklist.name: Key message leads the opening paragraph
checklist.description: Opening paragraph states what happened, the business impact, and what decision or action is needed — not background context.

checklist.name: Technical jargon translated or removed
checklist.description: All technical terms (Nginx, Kubernetes, ConfigMap, OPA Gatekeeper, IaC) are replaced with plain-language equivalents or removed entirely.

checklist.name: Acronyms defined on first use
checklist.description: Any acronyms retained in the rewrite (e.g., API, UTC, MTTR) are defined inline on their first occurrence.

checklist.name: Decision not buried
checklist.description: The budget request or recommendation is not buried after multiple paragraphs of technical background.

checklist.name: Avoids: Audience is not identified or acknowledged before...
checklist.description: Failure avoided: Audience is not identified or acknowledged before the rewrite

checklist.name: Avoids: Opening paragraph starts with technical background rather...
checklist.description: Failure avoided: Opening paragraph starts with technical background rather than business impact and the decision needed

checklist.name: Avoids: Technical terms like Nginx, Kubernetes, ConfigMap, or...
checklist.description: Failure avoided: Technical terms like Nginx, Kubernetes, ConfigMap, or OPA Gatekeeper appear without translation

checklist.name: Avoids: Acronyms (API, UTC, MTTR) are used without...
checklist.description: Failure avoided: Acronyms (API, UTC, MTTR) are used without inline definitions on first use

checklist.name: Avoids: Budget request or recommendation appears only at...
checklist.description: Failure avoided: Budget request or recommendation appears only at the end after extensive technical explanation
